title: suck_pull: no MAX_ARTICLE_BYTES guard on accumulated body — peer can OOM the process
description: suck_pull.rs fetch_article(): dot-terminated body accumulates into body: Vec<u8> with no size limit. A malicious remote NNTP server can stream an unbounded article body causing OOM. The ingestion path (check_ingest) enforces MAX_ARTICLE_BYTES, but the accumulation happens before check_ingest is called — after all the bytes have been received. Should add a body size check per iteration of the read loop (e.g. if body.len() > MAX_ARTICLE_BYTES { drop connection; return Failed }), matching the guard in session.rs:read_dot_stuffed.
